# Deployability Checklist: Voice Satellite Core Client
**Purpose**: Validate that spec and plan requirements fully satisfy the "publicly deployable and hardware-agnostic" mandate across configuration, dependency isolation, error handling, and OpenClaw protocol alignment
**Created**: 2026-05-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///home/aiden/Projects/voice-satellite/specs/001-voice-satellite-core/spec.md) · [plan.md](file:///home/aiden/Projects/voice-satellite/specs/001-voice-satellite-core/plan.md)
**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
## Configuration Completeness
- [x] CHK001 — Are all service URLs (OpenClaw gateway, Genie TTS) specified as configuration-driven with explicit env var names in the data model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Config Module]
- [x] CHK002 — Is the fail-fast behaviour for missing security-sensitive values (tokens) explicitly defined with the exact list of which values are required vs. optional? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK003 — Are all audio-related parameters (sample rates, VAD thresholds, wakeword confidence, silence timeout range) specified as configurable with documented defaults and valid ranges? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-019, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK004 — Is there a requirement that `.env.example` MUST enumerate every configuration variable with placeholder values and inline documentation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Constitution §II]
- [x] CHK005 — Are model path configurations (Whisper model name, ONNX model directory, reference audio path) specified as configuration-driven with no default paths that reference a specific user's filesystem? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK006 — Is the gateway protocol version range (min/max) specified as configurable rather than hardcoded, with documented defaults? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Clarification Q5]
- [x] CHK007 — Is the filler latency threshold (default 2 s) specified as configurable with a documented env var, not just a magic constant? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 — Are server bind address and port specified as configurable, and is the default (0.0.0.0:8000) explicitly documented as overridable? [Completeness, Plan §SatelliteConfig]
- [x] CHK009 — Is the "skip Genie init" development flag documented as a configuration option with its implications for degraded-mode operation clearly stated? [Clarity, Plan §SatelliteConfig]
- [x] CHK010 — Are all configuration categories (gateway, TTS, STT, filler, server, feature flags) consistently represented in both the spec requirements and the plan's SatelliteConfig dataclass? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Config Module]
## Dependency Isolation
- [x] CHK011 — Are ONNX wakeword model files specified as user-provided assets placed in a documented directory, not bundled or hardcoded in the repository? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Wakeword Engine]
- [x] CHK012 — Is the wakeword model format documented with a schema (`model.json` fields: file, name, sample_rate, threshold), enabling users to swap wakeword models without code changes? [Clarity, Plan §Wakeword Engine]
- [x] CHK013 — Are the vendored WASM assets (onnxruntime-web, VAD bundle, Silero ONNX models) specified as static files served locally, with no runtime CDN download dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK014 — Is the Genie TTS server specified as an external dependency (separate deployment), not embedded in the satellite — and is the boundary between client and server clearly documented? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, Plan §TTS Engine]
- [x] CHK015 — Are Python backend dependencies specified in a `requirements.txt` (or equivalent) that installs via standard `pip`, with no platform-specific binary dependencies that would break cross-architecture (x86_64/aarch64) deployment? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK016 — Is the faster-whisper STT model specified as auto-downloadable on first run, avoiding the need to pre-bundle large model files in the repository? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 — Are the pre-rendered filler PCM files specified as optional (graceful degradation if missing), with a documented generation script rather than requiring manual TTS synthesis? [Completeness, Plan §Filler Engine, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK018 — Is the Ed25519 device identity key pair specified as auto-generated on first run if missing, avoiding a mandatory pre-deployment setup step? [Clarity, Plan §Network/Protocol Layer]
- [x] CHK019 — Are frontend dependencies (VAD library, ONNX runtime) specified to require no build step (no npm/webpack), so the frontend is deployable by serving static files? [Completeness, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK020 — Is the virtual environment for the Genie TTS server specified as independent from the satellite's own venv, with no cross-contamination of dependencies? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, Plan §Bootstrap]
## Robust Error Handling
- [x] CHK021 — Is the microphone disconnection / permission denial scenario specified with explicit recovery behaviour (display status, re-attempt on reconnect)? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 — Is the degraded-mode state for TTS server unavailability fully defined — what functionality remains available and what is suspended? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Spec US3 §AS-2]
- [x] CHK023 — Is the degraded-mode state for gateway unavailability fully defined — is it explicitly stated that wakeword/VAD continue and only agent responses are suspended? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Clarification Q3]
- [x] CHK024 — Is the exponential backoff strategy specified with all required parameters: initial delay, multiplier, maximum cap (60 s), and retry limit (unlimited)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Clarification Q3]
- [x] CHK025 — Is the requirement to never speak error stack traces via TTS explicitly stated, with the alternative (UI status indicators + structured logs) specified? [Completeness, Constitution §VI, Spec US2 §AS-5]
- [x] CHK026 — Are TTS per-sentence errors specified with skip-and-continue behaviour, ensuring one failed sentence doesn't abort the entire response? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 — Is the rapid successive speech segment scenario specified — does the requirement clearly state that the in-flight pipeline for the first segment MUST be cancelled? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK028 — Is the WebSocket disconnection during active playback specified with explicit client-side behaviour (stop playback, show indicator, attempt reconnect)? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 — Is the session rejection scenario specified with a clear error message format and WebSocket close code for the rejected client? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a, Plan §Session Enforcement]
- [x] CHK030 — Are startup health check failures specified with distinction between hard failures (exit) and soft failures (warn + degrade)? Which services fall into which category? [Clarity, Plan §Bootstrap Sequence]
- [x] CHK031 — Is the behaviour defined when the Whisper STT model fails to download at startup? Is this a hard or soft failure? [Gap, Plan §Bootstrap]
- [x] CHK032 — Are resource cleanup requirements defined for barge-in cancellation — specifically, that in-flight HTTP requests to the TTS server and asyncio tasks are properly cancelled? [Completeness, Spec US3 §AS-6, Spec §FR-010]
## OpenClaw Multi-Agent Protocol Alignment
- [x] CHK033 — Is the gateway authentication flow specified with all three phases (connect with token → challenge/nonce → signed response), aligned with the legacy protocol v3 handshake? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Network/Protocol]
- [x] CHK034 — Is the protocol version negotiation specified with both min and max boundaries, and is the requirement to make these configurable explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Clarification Q5]
- [x] CHK035 — Are both agent interaction modes (one-shot and persistent/session-based) specified with distinct requirements for when each is used? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK036 — Is the persistent OpenClaw gateway connection protocol and automatic reconnection policy specified, including exponential backoff? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027, Plan §Network/Protocol Layer]
- [x] CHK037 — Is the proactive session reactivation requirement (gateway async message/notification received while passive) specified with the exact sequence: play ack filler → speak summary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK038 — Are the allowed OpenClaw agent identifiers (`main`, `ugin`) and optional client-side routing criteria specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK039 — Is the direct OpenClaw response streaming (split sentence-by-sentence to TTS) specified with latency-based thinking fillers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK040 — Is the conversation history management (barge-in partial response context prepending in next prompt) specified with sufficient detail for consistent context? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK041 — Is the interruption context prepended to the next prompt when a barge-in occurs specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK042 — Is the conversation end handling specified, transitioning the session back to passive listening? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
## Notes
- This checklist validates requirements quality across the spec (spec.md), plan
  (plan.md), and design artifacts (research.md, data-model.md, contracts/) —
  not implementation correctness.
- Items marked `[Gap]` indicate requirements that may be absent entirely and
  should be added to the spec or plan before implementation begins.
- Items referencing `Clarification Q#` trace to decisions recorded in
  `spec.md § Clarifications > Session 2026-05-19`.
- Cross-reference with `constitution.md` principles I–VI where noted.
